B-ALLOC-SEAM.scope: Production allocation/release call sites listed in atlas-refresh/site-worklist.json.  The join is exact on (file, line); each matched census operation on that line is attributed.

B-DESTRUCTOR.predicate: kind == UNSAFE_IMPL and impl trait in DESTRUCTOR_TRAITS, OR enclosing fn name ends with destroy_body
B-DESTRUCTOR.scope: unsafe impls of the destructor traits enumerated in DESTRUCTOR-CONTRACTS.md (CtxDestroy, CipherDestroy, KdfDestroy, MacDestroy, DrbgCtx, GcmDestroy, FreeOnDrop, Drop) and definitions of *_destroy_body.  Send/Sync and other unsafe impls are deliberately not attributed here.

B-FFI-ABI.scope: Every EXTERN_C_FN_DEF and every non-allocator CRYPTO_* / OPENSSL_* / ossl_* call recorded by the census that is not already claimed by an earlier, more specific boundary.  This is residual coverage-by-policy at the ABI edge, not a per-site ABI proof; allocator calls are covered by B-ALLOC-SEAM instead.

B-LOCK.coverage: per-site within a declared mechanism scope
B-LOCK.predicate: file == src/runtime/thread.rs OR \bCRYPTO_THREAD_ in the enclosing fn / line window
B-LOCK.scope: Sites in src/runtime/thread.rs and remaining sites whose enclosing function or immediate source window references CRYPTO_THREAD_*.  Evaluated after B-ALLOC-SEAM and B-REFCOUNT.

B-OPAQUE.scope: Remaining sites in the opaque-representation files named in OPAQUE-REPRESENTATIONS.md: src/runtime/thread.rs, src/runtime/stack.rs, src/runtime/lhash.rs, src/bn/recp.rs.  Sites already claimed by an earlier boundary keep that boundary; this is file-level representation coverage, not a per-site proof.

B-OWNER-ADOPT.predicate: enclosing fn name in OWNER_CTOR_NAMES AND impl header/function mentions a shared owner type AND an adopt-ish token is present
B-OWNER-ADOPT.scope: unsafe adopt/from_raw/RawCtx/assume_init/into_raw sites whose enclosing constructor is associated with one of the shared owner types OwnedBuf, OwnedStr, OwnedCtx, RawCtx or OwnedBlock.  Local owner types with other names are left unattributed.

B-REFCOUNT.coverage: per-site within a declared mechanism scope
B-REFCOUNT.predicate: file == src/runtime/refcount.rs OR \b(down_ref|up_ref)\s*\( in the enclosing fn / line window
B-REFCOUNT.scope: Sites in src/runtime/refcount.rs and remaining sites whose enclosing function or immediate source window references up_ref/down_ref.  Evaluated after B-ALLOC-SEAM.

source_identity.source_read_from: pinned census candidate commit via git archive; the working tree is never read for line context

statement: Attribution is not discharge.  A site under a boundary is covered by that boundary's declared scope only; no caller contract, aliasing proof, lifetime proof or cryptographic property is established.  UNATTRIBUTED is an explicit queue, not a claim of safety or a claim of defect.
